parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, typically made of durable plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that releases the pressurized contents when pressed, controlling the spray or dispensing mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position after release due to internal spring or pressure.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of aluminum to withstand internal pressure.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the pressurized liquid or gas and provides structural integrity to the dispenser.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main housing for the internal contents.
